If(IsBlank(varRole), "Sign in to see your tickets", varEmail & " · " & varRole & If(IsBlank(varDept), "", " · " & varDept))

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString: Switch(varRole, "Supervisor", If(IsBlank(varDept), "My assigned tickets", varDept & " department tickets"), "Admin", "My assigned tickets", "My submitted tickets")

Rules.InvariantScript: If(varView = "Submitted", "View assigned tickets", "View my submitted tickets")
If((varRole = "Admin" || varRole = "Supervisor") && varView <> "Submitted", "My assigned tickets", "My submitted tickets")

Sort(If((varRole = "Admin" || varRole = "Supervisor") && varView <> "Submitted", Filter(AdministrativeServiceRequests, Lower(AssignedTo) = Lower(varEmail)), Filter(AdministrativeServiceRequests, Lower(RequestedBy) = Lower(varEmail))), RequestDate, SortOrder.Descending)
